decisions.reason: The project-ending message does not independently change or delete the established peak-alignment attributes; the source removal is not a design decision that replaces the alignment rule.
Ending revisions and removing the accent-derivation requirement does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes.
The removal of literal accent derivation does not alter the independent rule aligning both V bottom points with the E and L baseline.
